title: E-commerce Sales Coordinator

questions: Contract role (12 months). Is a fixed-term contract acceptable?

reasons.love: Customer-facing commercial work close to his preferred Key Account track.
reasons.good_at: F20 and F25 show leadership and communication in a student-run company; F26 shows Excel reporting.
reasons.needs: Stable employer, but the JD names no development path.
reasons.paid: Estimate: the posting states no salary. about THB 30,000-40,000 per month. for a comparable Bangkok graduate role.

summary: Strong fit on role and growth; confirm the open questions before applying.
jd_text: Kraft Heinz Thailand is hiring for E-commerce Sales Coordinator in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
